goals: Verify the correctness of the Levenshtein distance calculation between two strings for various similarity scenarios
activities: Calculate Levenshtein distance for identical strings 'aaa' and 'aaa' and verify result equals 0
Calculate Levenshtein distance for different strings 'abc' and 'def' and verify result equals 3
Calculate Levenshtein distance for similar strings 'gmail.com' and 'gnail.com' and verify result equals 1
Calculate Levenshtein distance for strings 'gmail.com' and 'gnaul.com' and verify result equals 2
Calculate Levenshtein distance for strings 'mail.com' and 'gnaul.com' and verify result equals 3
